description: A dark night desert scene. A boxy, angled multi-canister missile launcher sits on a military truck, firing a bright fiery missile whose trail arcs up across a black sky. A second streak falls from the upper right, and a faint city skyline glows low on the horizon. Ground is rubble-strewn sand with a small box unit nearby. No people, no visible text beyond a faint painter's mark in the lower right corner.
